run.label: frames that show only the wood pile

findings.instruction: Move the stacked logs at least 30 feet from the wall, or drape sheet metal fully over them.
findings.reason: The frames show an uncovered stack of logs sitting tight against the house wall.

findings.instruction: Swap the first 5 feet of fence by the house for metal, brick or another material that will not burn.
findings.reason: The frames show only the log stack and wall, with no clear view of the fence spot.

findings.instruction: Cut the dry brush patches and haul them to the green waste bin for pickup.
findings.reason: The frames show bare dirt by the house and give no view that rules out brush farther out.
